project: PRISM description pools for hateful video (label-free baseline, 2026-10-08)
description: Generated from the policy text only (hate_query.md); no video, transcript or label used.

generator.class_prompt:
A video platform's hate speech policy prohibits content that does the following:
"{rule}"

Write {n} different one-sentence descriptions of what a short video segment that violates this rule could show or contain: what is seen on screen, what is said or sung, or what text appears. Make the descriptions concrete and varied (different formats such as speeches, memes, vlogs, music videos, animations, news-style clips, livestreams). Refer to targeted groups only generically (for example "a religious group" or "an ethnic minority"); do not name real people, groups or events. Keep each sentence under 25 words.
Output exactly {n} lines, numbered 1 to {n}, and nothing else.
generator.normal_prompt:
A video platform's hate speech policy prohibits content that does any of the following:
{rules}

Write {n} different one-sentence descriptions of ordinary short video segments that do not violate any of these rules: what is seen on screen, what is said or sung, or what text appears. Make them concrete and varied (vlogs, tutorials, news reports, gaming, music, sports, comedy, interviews, animations, livestreams). Do not name real people. Keep each sentence under 25 words.
Output exactly {n} lines, numbered 1 to {n}, and nothing else.

class_overrides.R1: Encourage violence against groups based on protected status
class_overrides.R2: Incite hatred against groups based on protected status
class_overrides.R3: Dehumanize groups by comparing to non-human entities
class_overrides.R4: Praise or glorify violence against protected groups
class_overrides.R5: Use slurs and stereotypes that incite hatred (including through humor, irony, or coded language)
class_overrides.R6: Claim groups are inferior based on protected status
class_overrides.R8: Make conspiratorial claims about groups based on protected status
class_overrides.R9: Deny or minimize major violent events
class_overrides.Q: hateful content that attacks or demeans people based on protected attributes
